description: Lists component names, optionally limited to one category, one line each with the name and the category slug. Use it to browse a category before choosing; use search_components instead when you already have a keyword. Returns names only, no source: fetch the code with get_component. Works without a key; without one, the components whose source is free are marked "free".

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, e.g. 'heroes', 'cta', 'pricing', 'forms', 'footer'. Omit it to list every component (more than 600).

name: list_components
title: List components
